Retained Rust/Go foundations: greetings, variables, functions, loops, borrowing/slices, structs, fallible totals, iterators/interfaces/tests, word counting and concurrent reports. Retained SQL: select, anti-join, paid aggregation, deterministic window ranking and transaction/client recovery.

Python is supplied by #38 when its adapter lands; its starter track is preserved on integration. Java, C#, YAML and their ecosystem lessons remain gated on their language tickets. HTML/CSS and JavaScript are now on main and receive tracks here. Go third-party frameworks remain with their language/library ticket; these lessons use supported standard libraries plus the existing database/sql companion.
